name: 3D Grid Rasterization
definition: Voxelize a mesh and snap the resulting voxel centers to a fixed-width, height, and depth 3D grid, returning a flat array of ABGR colors.
summary: 3D Grid Rasterization is a CPU-based algorithm that converts triangle meshes into binary occupancy grids by projecting triangles onto orthogonal planes and filling scanlines, omitting complex surface reconstruction steps.
